cells.scene: An accomplished scientist receives a medal from peers beside their laboratory work, dignified recognition.
A very high snow-covered pyramidal Himalayan peak rises above lower rugged mountain ranges, a tiny climber below gives scale; Everest geographic mnemonic.
An adult carefully wades knee-deep through shallow clear water, trouser legs rolled up and riverbed visible.
A clear waterfall cascades from a rocky ledge into a blue pool, natural greenery around the edge.

prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE SQUARE 2x2 atlas with four equal square cells for an adult vocabulary app. Attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: restrained ink-and-watercolor educational illustrations, clear dark blue-charcoal outlines, pale blue wash, small warm natural color accents. Pure WHITE opaque background. Central 75% of each quadrant contains its subject with generous margins. Nothing crosses midlines. Leave horizontal 45–55% and vertical 47–53% center bands EMPTY WHITE. Natural human anatomy, recognizable objects, clear 320px silhouettes, restrained detail, no elaborate environment. NO captions, labels, writing, borders, grid lines, watermarks or logos. Only symbols or numerals explicitly requested in a cell are allowed. Meanings are guidance; never write them. Row-major fixed order. FOUR CELLS:
TOP LEFT — distinguished (a.杰出的，著名的): An accomplished scientist receives a medal from peers beside their laboratory work, dignified recognition.
TOP RIGHT — Everest (n.珠穆朗玛峰): A very high snow-covered pyramidal Himalayan peak rises above lower rugged mountain ranges, a tiny climber below gives scale; Everest geographic mnemonic.
BOTTOM LEFT — wade (v.涉水): An adult carefully wades knee-deep through shallow clear water, trouser legs rolled up and riverbed visible.
BOTTOM RIGHT — waterfall (n.瀑布): A clear waterfall cascades from a rocky ledge into a blue pool, natural greenery around the edge.
CROP SAFETY: each scene has 20% white margins inside its own quadrant. Top drawings fully end ABOVE 45% image height. Bottom-row heads, hair, thought bubbles and main objects begin BELOW 58% total image height. Nothing crosses midlines.
review_notes: Reviewed complete contained scenes, recognizability and meaning. Stalagmite grows from floor, waterspout is pressurized water column, boom is sound resonance. Geographic art is illustrative mnemonic. Waterfall rejected for 204960-byte output; simpler replacement queued.
